name: 岭南花窗
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-screen painterly mobile game background artwork, without interface.
Primary request: 岭南花窗 — sunny Cantonese old-town street veranda, seen obliquely from within one sweeping asymmetric colored-glass arched window. This is a real architecture scene with strong perspective and depth, radically different from a decorative restaurant paperwall.
Canvas: tall portrait aspect 720:1520, edge-to-edge, no phone frame.
Scene and composition: One large finely carved deep-teal and dark teak arch sweeps diagonally across upper-left toward top-right but is asymmetrical, with emerald, cobalt, cyan and golden amber stained-glass panes along the arch. From the arch/veranda see a sunny old Guangzhou street: a few beautifully modeled pastel pink, cream and pale turquoise colonial arcade shophouses with small arched balconies, intricate facade reliefs and palm greenery receding into distance across the upper third only. Clear warm daylight and sky, tropical jade foliage at extreme upper-right. The central and lower 70% of the view opens onto a broad pale mint-and-ivory terrazzo veranda floor/large seamless terrazzo playing plane in perspective. A subtle faded fine multicolor stone aggregate, no large high-contrast patterns in middle. Sunny saturated glass reflections lie mostly along extreme side edges and upper boundary. Cropped curve of one honey rattan chair back only far right lower edge; a tiny elegant patterned porcelain teacup and saucer tucked into far bottom-left. Floor geometry and colored-glass architecture dominate. The terrazzo surface is horizontal and visibly belongs to a veranda, not a blank vertical plaster wall or paper panel; buildings set behind the plane rather than within playing area.
Overlay clearance: Tile cards will be placed in x21-75%, y34-57%; keep that entire area uncluttered very light mint/ivory terrazzo with low-contrast fine speckles and no hard objects, lines, chair, architectural edges or strong shadows. Lower y74-83% and y91-97% equally calm for future tray/buttons. Do not draw UI or tray.
Style: premium rich handpainted casual game illustration, polished stylized 3D volume with painterly textures, translucent thick colored glass, sunlit stone chips and rattan weave, old Cantonese facade craftsmanship. Cheerful cyan/emerald/cobalt glass and pale mint/cream plane, peach architecture in sun. Sophisticated and tactile, not flat vector or photorealistic.
Absolute exclusions: no text, no letters, no signage, no logos, no UI, no game tiles or food sprites, no tray, no menus, no buttons, no character. No fabric curtains/swags, no twin lanterns, no vases or pedestals, no paperwall, no copperpot, no wood tabletop, no repeated lower-quarter horizon. No symmetric border frame. Single complete background scene.
firstAttemptIssue: Balustrade overlapped the fixed tile-card area at y34-40%.
revisionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: tall portrait background game illustration.
Edit target: the referenced sunny Cantonese veranda illustration. Preserve its beautiful painterly materials, mint/cream terrazzo, cyan/emerald/cobalt colored glass, pastel Cantonese architecture, rattan chair and small teacup.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION FIX: tilt the camera significantly farther downward, move the entire balustrade, street buildings, palms and horizon much farther back and UP within the image. The bottom edge of all balustrade/architectural rail details must be above 28% image height. The complete middle region between y29% and bottom must be broad continuous light mint/cream terrazzo floor, with perspective depth and low contrast fine aggregate. Card overlay area x21-75%, y34-57% must contain ONLY pale terrazzo, no rail, pillar, architectural line, plant or hard shadow. Keep colored sun patches toward extreme edges. Compress the view of buildings and sky to upper 27%; the colored-glass arch sweeps from upper-left across top edge, not into central playing area. Retain the sense of the same real sunlit veranda and exterior street beyond, not an indoor wall. Rattan chair remains a small crop at far lower-right edge, tiny teacup at far lower-left.
Preserve tall portrait 720:1520 aspect. No text, lettering, UI, logo, tiles, tray, button, paperwall, curtains, lanterns, vases, copperpot or woodtable. Single complete illustration.
